sources.review_notes: Focused planning, delegation and review references adapt Superpowers 6.4.2 and the retired standalone delegation workflow under retained MIT attribution. Existing activation, test ownership and authority boundaries remain canonical; no Superpowers runtime dependency.

Independently authored summary of useful map, text, caption normalization and trim concepts from the retired standalone Remotion package. The installed official Remotion plugin owns APIs and general rules; no duplicate runtime or legacy code assets required.

Consolidated investigation contract, informed by Superpowers systematic-debugging (installed 6.4.2) and the retired investigate workflow. Supporting tracing, waiting and defense references are retained from Superpowers. No gstack runtime, hooks, telemetry or update dependency remains.

Vercel Engineering React/Next.js guidelines retained from Build Web Apps 0.1.2. The 58 standalone rule files were identical to their counterparts; the plugin copy additionally supplied eight rule/section/template files. A concise independent review checklist incorporates the Vercel plugin review scope. Plugin caches remain vendor-owned.

Consolidates installed frontend-design, Impeccable mode references/helpers, and make-interfaces-feel-better detail references. No private project contexts or runtime state are included. Paths and invocation are adapted to frontend-design; upstream self-update is removed so Agent OS owns the combined package. Existing .impeccable project state stays compatible.

Human-approved hybrid supervisor: persistent #SV supervisor goal, bounded subagents by default and separate worker goals for concrete independent lifecycle/visibility or tool-availability benefits. Both routes preserve authority, one-writer isolation, dispatch reconciliation, correction and cooperative stop. Fresh independent final audit and current-state acceptance remain mandatory. No configured budgets or private app bridge; workflow guidance is not an app-enforced completion lock.
Independently authored, explicitly invoked research-to-decision workflow. Human approval gates native same-thread goal launch and execution; unavailable goal controls have an honest manual fallback.

Retains adapted Superpowers 6.4.2 regression/assertion-design references with MIT attribution. Independently authored, agent-callable coverage workflow with bounded worker handoff and parent acceptance. The measure/add/verify/report loop was informed by ECC commands/test-coverage.md; no ECC runtime or Superpowers dependency. Provenance and behavioral evaluation criteria live in references/fault-checks.md.

Reviewed NoteBridge 1.0.1 source 88d826a: compact batched metadata and pagination; explicit raw_content, rich views and image references; validated creation/diff/hash previews, append/replace/move/delete, stale-write refusal and read-back. Preserve spacing, blank lines, list markers and link destinations. Whole-document replacements disclose formatting loss. Attachment and native list/table body edits fail closed; checklist completion and native history are unavailable; new HTML image import is refused; native writes have no atomic CAS.
Native Urgent is unsupported. Use a timed alarm when timing matters and leave priority unset unless the user explicitly requests a supported priority.
Upstream README and commands/auth.mdx reviewed for install and credential names on 2026-09-09. No binary version pinned, installed, or audited; brew install asc requires deliberate installation.

Reviewed Cloudflare/deployment consolidation, frontend QA/helper retention, installed-first skill discovery, provider-scoped overlays and focused outcome/bottleneck contracts. Plugin overlays are pinned, preview-first and refuse unknown content; no auth or account state included.

Independently authored adaptive inquiry guidance. Questions, order and depth arise from the situation; a revisable working goal directs attention and methods remain selective. Comparative evaluation and limits are documented separately; no runtime, external service or private data dependency.

Official README, installation guide and published npm interface reviewed 2026-10-18. CLI-first integration; Node ^22.19.0, ^24.11.0 or >=26.0.0. Static JavaScript and built-in Mach-O inspection verified without a decompiler. Optional native providers and Frida are separate prerequisites. No bundled upstream skill, MCP registration, provider installation, login or auto-update is implied.
